scanNote:
14-UNITNING BEShINChI BETI (102-bet) - ITLAR YaXShI UY HAYVONIMI?

Yuqorida chapda TO'Q SARIQ yorliqda oq '14' va 'Live and Let Live'.

CHAP USTUN:
• To'q sariq 'Reading and Listening'.
17) 'Read the sentences and circle the correct answer.' 1 A WONDERFUL COMPANION is a person/animal that ... a you always enjoy being with. b works with you. 2 A dog WAGS ITS TAIL by ... a holding it straight out and not moving it. b moving it quickly from side to side. 3 A person or animal that is LOYAL will ... a always be your friend, in good times or bad times. b try to trick you or hurt you. 4 THE ELDERLY are ... a sick people. b old people. 5 THE BLIND are people who ... a can't talk. b can't see.
18) 'Read the statements and tick the ones you agree with. Then, make sentences using I (don't) think ..., as in the example.' 1 Dogs make wonderful companions. 2 Dogs are shy animals. 3 Dogs are extremely loyal to their owners. 4 Dogs are good company for the elderly and for children. 5 Dogs are easy to train as watchdogs. 6 Dogs can't be taught all sorts of tricks. 7 Dogs need a lot of attention. 8 Dogs don't need to be taken for regular visits to the vet. 9 Dogs can be tiring. Ko'k qiya: 'I think dogs make perfect companions. I don't think dogs are shy animals.'
19) 'Read the article and answer the questions.' 1 • What is the writer's personal opinion about dogs as house pets? • In which paragraph does she state her opinion? • What words/phrases does she use to express her opinion? 2 • In which two paragraphs does the writer support her opinion? • How does each paragraph start? • What points does she mention? 3 • Which paragraph mentions the opposing point of view? • How does this paragraph start? 4 Which of the words in bold... • list points? • express contrast? • summarise what has been mentioned before?

O'NG TOMON: SURAT - oq kuchukchani quchoqlagan bola. Sariq sarlavha 'Do dogs make good pets?' 'by Susan Mills'. OCh KO'K MATN:
1: 'You've decided to add a pet to your family - but what pet is right? I THINK that the person who said that a dog is "man's best friend" is absolutely right. In my opinion, dogs make perfect house pets.'
2: 'FIRST OF ALL, dogs make wonderful companions. They always show their happiness as soon as their owner walks through the door, by wagging their tail and jumping up and down excitedly. They are playful and extremely loyal to their owners, so they are good company for the elderly and for children.'
3: 'FURTHERMORE, trained dogs are useful to their owners. They are easy to train as watchdogs to guard your house and family, making you feel safe and secure. They can also be trained as guide dogs for the blind. They can be taught all sorts of tricks - even to collect the morning newspaper!'
4: 'ON THE OTHER HAND, dogs need a lot of attention. They need to be fed and brushed, and taken for their daily walk or regular visit to the vet. HOWEVER, this is a small price to pay in exchange for their friendship and loyalty.'
5: 'ALL IN ALL, although having a dog can be tiring, I BELIEVE that they are the best pets. Spending a little time with your dog every day will certainly win you a "best friend" for life.'
20) Kasseta belgisi: 'Listen and mark the sentences as T (true) or F (false). Then, listen again and correct the false statements, as in the example.' 1 Dogs make bad house pets. F - ko'k qiya 'Dogs make perfect house pets.' 2 They never show their happiness. 3 They are playful. 4 They are difficult to train as watchdogs. 5 Dogs don't need any attention. 6 Having a dog can be tiring.
• To'q sariq 'Speaking': 'Read the article again and take notes under these headings, then talk about dogs as pets.' - writer's opinion - writer's viewpoint & reasons - opposing viewpoint & reasons.

Bet raqami: pastda chapda '102'.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the sentences and circle the correct answer.
exercises.instructionUz: Gaplarni o'qing va to'g'ri javobni aylantiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
MATN LUG'ATI:

  1 a - companion = hamroh (birga
    bo'lish yoqadigan)
  2 b - wag its tail = dumini
    likillatmoq
  3 a - loyal = sodiq
  4 b - the elderly = keksalar
  5 b - the blind = ko'zi ojizlar


⚠ 'THE + SIFAT' = ODAMLAR GURUHI:

  the elderly = keksalar
  the blind = ko'zi ojizlar
  the rich = boylar
  the poor = kambag'allar
  ⚠ Ko'plik ma'noda!


⚠ 'A COMPANION':

  = hamroh, do'st.


⚠ 'TO WAG':

  = likillatmoq (dum).


⚠ 'LOYAL':

  = sodiq.
  ⚠ 'loyalty' = sodiqlik.

2 A dog wags its tail by ...

moving it quickly from side to side.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the statements and tick the ones you agree with. Then, make sentences using I (don't) think ..., as in the example. 1 Dogs make wonderful companions. 2 Dogs are shy animals. 3 Dogs are extremely loyal to their owners. 4 Dogs are good company for the elderly and for children. 5 Dogs are easy to train as watchdogs. 6 Dogs can't be taught all sorts of tricks. 7 Dogs need a lot of attention. 8 Dogs don't need to be taken for regular visits to the vet. 9 Dogs can be tiring.
exercises.instructionUz: Gaplarni o'qing va rozi bo'lganlaringizni belgilang. Keyin namunadagidek 'I (don't) think ...' bilan gaplar tuzing. 1 Itlar ajoyib hamroh. 2 Itlar uyatchan hayvonlar. 3 Itlar egalariga juda sodiq. 4 Itlar keksalar va bolalar uchun yaxshi hamroh. 5 Itlarni qo'riqchi it sifatida o'rgatish oson. 6 Itlarga har xil fokuslarni o'rgatib bo'lmaydi. 7 Itlarga ko'p e'tibor kerak. 8 Itlarni muntazam veterinarga olib borish shart emas. 9 Itlar charchatishi mumkin.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  'I think dogs make perfect
   companions.'
  'I don't think dogs are shy
   animals.'

  ⚠ ROZI → 'I think ...'
  ⚠ ROZI EMAS → 'I don't think ...'
  ⚠ Inglizchada inkor 'think'ga
  qo'yiladi: 'I don't think dogs
  are shy' ('I think dogs aren't
  shy' - kamroq).


⚠ MATN BO'YIChA (Susan Mills
fikri): 1, 3, 4, 5, 7, 9 - to'g'ri;
2, 6, 8 - noto'g'ri.


⚠ 'SHY':

  = uyatchan.


⚠ 'A WATCHDOG':

  = qo'riqchi it.


⚠ 'ATTENTION':

  = e'tibor.


⚠ 'TIRING':

  = charchatuvchi.
exercises.exampleEn: I think dogs make perfect companions. I don't think dogs are shy animals.
exercises.exampleUz: Menimcha, itlar mukammal hamroh. Menimcha, itlar uyatchan hayvonlar emas.
modelAnswers: I think dogs are extremely loyal to their owners.
I think dogs are good company for the elderly and for children.
I think dogs are easy to train as watchdogs.
I don't think dogs can't be taught tricks - they can learn all sorts of tricks.
I think dogs need a lot of attention.
I don't think dogs can go without regular visits to the vet.
I think dogs can be tiring.
modelAnswersUz: Menimcha, itlar keksalar va bolalar uchun yaxshi hamroh.
Menimcha, itlarni qo'riqchi it sifatida o'rgatish oson.
Menimcha, itlarga fokus o'rgatib bo'lmaydi degan gap noto'g'ri - ular har xil fokuslarni o'rganadi.
Menimcha, itlarni veterinarga olib bormaslik mumkin emas.

exercises.instructionEn: Do dogs make good pets? by Susan Mills
exercises.instructionUz: Itlar yaxshi uy hayvonimi? Susan Mills
exercises.explanationUz:
MATN TARJIMASI:

1) Oilangizga uy hayvoni qo'shishga
qaror qildingiz - lekin qaysi uy
hayvoni to'g'ri? Menimcha, itni
"insonning eng yaxshi do'sti" degan
odam mutlaqo haq. Mening fikrimcha,
itlar mukammal uy hayvoni.

2) Avvalo, itlar ajoyib hamroh.
Egasi eshikdan kirishi bilanoq ular
dumini likillatib va hayajon bilan
sakrab, xursandchiligini ko'rsatadi.
Ular o'ynoqi va egalariga juda
sodiq, shuning uchun keksalar va
bolalar uchun yaxshi hamroh.

3) Bundan tashqari, o'rgatilgan itlar
egalariga foydali. Ularni uyingiz va
oilangizni qo'riqlash uchun qo'riqchi
it sifatida o'rgatish oson - bu
sizga xavfsizlik hissini beradi.
Ularni ko'zi ojizlar uchun
yo'lboshlovchi it sifatida ham
o'rgatish mumkin. Ularga har xil
fokuslarni o'rgatish mumkin - hatto
ertalabki gazetani olib kelishni ham!

4) Boshqa tomondan, itlarga ko'p
e'tibor kerak. Ularni boqish,
cho'tkalash, har kuni sayrga olib
chiqish yoki muntazam veterinarga
olib borish kerak. Biroq, bu ularning
do'stligi va sodiqligi evaziga
to'lanadigan kichik narx.

5) Umuman olganda, it saqlash
charchatishi mumkin bo'lsa ham, ular
eng yaxshi uy hayvoni deb ishonaman.
Har kuni itingiz bilan ozgina vaqt
o'tkazish sizga umrbod "eng yaxshi
do'st"ni albatta beradi.


BOG'LOVChILAR (qalin so'zlar):

  FIKR BILDIRISh:
    I think = menimcha
    In my opinion = mening fikrimcha
    I believe = ishonaman
  FIKRLARNI SANASh:
    First of all = avvalo
    Furthermore = bundan tashqari
  QARAMA-QARShI FIKR:
    On the other hand = boshqa
      tomondan
    However = biroq
  XULOSA:
    All in all = umuman olganda


⚠ 'MAN'S BEST FRIEND':

  = insonning eng yaxshi do'sti (it
  haqida ibora).


⚠ 'ABSOLUTELY':

  = mutlaqo.


⚠ 'AS SOON AS':

  = ...bilanoq.


⚠ 'TO GUARD':

  = qo'riqlamoq.


⚠ 'SAFE AND SECURE':

  = xavfsiz va himoyalangan.


⚠ 'A GUIDE DOG':

  = yo'lboshlovchi it (ko'zi ojizlar
  uchun).


⚠ 'ALL SORTS OF':

  = har xil.


⚠ 'TO BRUSH':

  = cho'tkalamoq.


⚠ 'A SMALL PRICE TO PAY':

  = arzimas narx (ibora).


⚠ 'IN EXCHANGE FOR':

  = ... evaziga.


⚠ 'FOR LIFE':

  = umrbod.

points.en: You've decided to add a pet to your family - but what pet is right? I think that the person who said that a dog is "man's best friend" is absolutely right. In my opinion, dogs make perfect house pets.

points.en: First of all, dogs make wonderful companions. They always show their happiness as soon as their owner walks through the door, by wagging their tail and jumping up and down excitedly. They are playful and extremely loyal to their owners, so they are good company for the elderly and for children.
points.uz: Avvalo, itlar ajoyib hamroh. Egasi eshikdan kirishi bilanoq ular dumini likillatib va hayajon bilan sakrab, xursandchiligini ko'rsatadi. Ular o'ynoqi va egalariga juda sodiq, shuning uchun keksalar va bolalar uchun yaxshi hamroh.

points.en: Furthermore, trained dogs are useful to their owners. They are easy to train as watchdogs to guard your house and family, making you feel safe and secure. They can also be trained as guide dogs for the blind. They can be taught all sorts of tricks - even to collect the morning newspaper!
points.uz: Bundan tashqari, o'rgatilgan itlar egalariga foydali. Ularni uyingiz va oilangizni qo'riqlash uchun qo'riqchi it sifatida o'rgatish oson - bu sizga xavfsizlik hissini beradi. Ularni ko'zi ojizlar uchun yo'lboshlovchi it sifatida ham o'rgatish mumkin. Ularga har xil fokuslarni o'rgatish mumkin - hatto ertalabki gazetani olib kelishni ham!

points.en: On the other hand, dogs need a lot of attention. They need to be fed and brushed, and taken for their daily walk or regular visit to the vet. However, this is a small price to pay in exchange for their friendship and loyalty.
points.uz: Boshqa tomondan, itlarga ko'p e'tibor kerak. Ularni boqish, cho'tkalash, har kuni sayrga olib chiqish yoki muntazam veterinarga olib borish kerak. Biroq, bu ularning do'stligi va sodiqligi evaziga to'lanadigan kichik narx.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the article and answer the questions.
exercises.instructionUz: Maqolani o'qing va savollarga javob bering.
exercises.explanationUz:
MAQOLA TUZILIShI (fikr bildiruvchi
maqola):

  1 - FIKR (I think, In my opinion)
  2 - 1-DALIL (First of all)
  3 - 2-DALIL (Furthermore)
  4 - QARAMA-QARShI FIKR (On the
      other hand, However)
  5 - XULOSA (All in all, I believe)


⚠ 'TO STATE':

  = bayon qilmoq.


⚠ 'TO SUPPORT':

  = qo'llab-quvvatlamoq (dalil
  bilan).


⚠ 'OPPOSING POINT OF VIEW':

  = qarama-qarshi nuqtai nazar.


⚠ 'TO EXPRESS CONTRAST':

  = qarama-qarshilikni bildirmoq.

items.en: 1 What is the writer's personal opinion about dogs as house pets? In which paragraph does she state her opinion? What words/phrases does she use to express her opinion?
items.uz: 1 Muallifning itlar uy hayvoni sifatida shaxsiy fikri qanday? U fikrini qaysi xatboshida bayon qiladi? Fikrini bildirish uchun qanday so'z/iboralar ishlatadi?
items.answerEn: She thinks dogs make perfect house pets. She states her opinion in paragraph 1. She uses 'I think' and 'In my opinion'.
items.answerUz: U itlar mukammal uy hayvoni deb hisoblaydi. Fikrini 1-xatboshida bayon qiladi. 'I think' va 'In my opinion' ni ishlatadi.

items.en: 2 In which two paragraphs does the writer support her opinion? How does each paragraph start? What points does she mention?
items.uz: 2 Muallif fikrini qaysi ikki xatboshida qo'llab-quvvatlaydi? Har xatboshi qanday boshlanadi? Qanday fikrlarni tilga oladi?
items.answerEn: In paragraphs 2 and 3. They start with 'First of all' and 'Furthermore'. She mentions that dogs are wonderful companions, playful and loyal, good company for the elderly and children, useful as watchdogs and guide dogs, and can be taught tricks.
items.answerUz: 2 va 3-xatboshilarda. Ular 'First of all' va 'Furthermore' bilan boshlanadi. U itlar ajoyib hamroh, o'ynoqi va sodiq, keksalar va bolalar uchun yaxshi hamroh, qo'riqchi va yo'lboshlovchi it sifatida foydali, fokus o'rganishini tilga oladi.

items.en: 3 Which paragraph mentions the opposing point of view? How does this paragraph start?
items.uz: 3 Qaysi xatboshi qarama-qarshi nuqtai nazarni tilga oladi? Bu xatboshi qanday boshlanadi?
items.answerEn: Paragraph 4. It starts with 'On the other hand'.
items.answerUz: 4-xatboshi. U 'On the other hand' bilan boshlanadi.

items.en: 4 Which of the words in bold list points? express contrast? summarise what has been mentioned before?
items.uz: 4 Qalin so'zlardan qaysilari fikrlarni sanaydi? qarama-qarshilikni bildiradi? oldin aytilganlarni umumlashtiradi?
items.answerEn: List points: 'First of all', 'Furthermore'. Express contrast: 'On the other hand', 'However'. Summarise: 'All in all'.
items.answerUz: Sanash: 'First of all', 'Furthermore'. Qarama-qarshilik: 'On the other hand', 'However'. Umumlashtirish: 'All in all'.

exercises.instructionEn: Listen and mark the sentences as T (true) or F (false). Then, listen again and correct the false statements, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Tinglang va gaplarni T (to'g'ri) yoki F (noto'g'ri) deb belgilang. Keyin yana tinglang va noto'g'ri gaplarni to'g'rilang, namunadagidek.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  1 Dogs make bad house pets. F
    → Dogs make PERFECT house pets.


JAVOBLAR (matn bo'yicha):
  2 F - They ALWAYS show their
    happiness.
  3 T
  4 F - They are EASY to train as
    watchdogs.
  5 F - Dogs need A LOT OF
    attention.
  6 T

  ⚠ Audio yo'q bo'lsa - matndan.

items.sentence: 4 They are difficult to train as watchdogs.
items.uz: 4 Ularni qo'riqchi it sifatida o'rgatish qiyin.
items.whyUz: ⚠ They are EASY to train as watchdogs.

items.uz: 5 Itlarga hech qanday e'tibor kerak emas.
items.whyUz: ⚠ Dogs need A LOT OF attention.

items.sentence: 6 Having a dog can be tiring.
items.whyUz: ⚠ Matn: 'having a dog can be tiring'.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the article again and take notes under these headings, then talk about dogs as pets. - writer's opinion - writer's viewpoint & reasons - opposing viewpoint & reasons
exercises.instructionUz: Maqolani yana o'qing va ushbu sarlavhalar ostida qaydlar yozing, keyin itlar uy hayvoni sifatida haqida gapiring. - muallif fikri - muallif nuqtai nazari va sabablari - qarama-qarshi nuqtai nazar va sabablari
exercises.explanationUz:
QAYDLAR:

  OPINION: dogs = perfect house
    pets
  VIEWPOINT & REASONS: wonderful
    companions - playful, loyal,
    good company; useful -
    watchdogs, guide dogs, tricks
  OPPOSING: need attention - fed,
    brushed, walk, vet; tiring


⚠ 'A VIEWPOINT':

  = nuqtai nazar.
exercises.exampleEn: The writer thinks that dogs make perfect house pets.
exercises.exampleUz: Muallif itlar mukammal uy hayvoni deb hisoblaydi.
modelAnswers: First of all, she says dogs are wonderful companions because they are playful and loyal, and they are good company for the elderly and children. Furthermore, trained dogs are useful as watchdogs and guide dogs, and they can learn tricks.
On the other hand, dogs need a lot of attention - they need to be fed, brushed and walked every day, and taken to the vet. Having a dog can be tiring.
All in all, the writer believes dogs are the best pets because they become your best friend for life.
modelAnswersUz: Avvalo, u itlar ajoyib hamroh deydi, chunki ular o'ynoqi va sodiq, keksalar va bolalar uchun yaxshi hamroh. Bundan tashqari, o'rgatilgan itlar qo'riqchi va yo'lboshlovchi it sifatida foydali va fokus o'rganadi.
Boshqa tomondan, itlarga ko'p e'tibor kerak - ularni har kuni boqish, cho'tkalash, sayr qildirish va veterinarga olib borish kerak. It saqlash charchatishi mumkin.
Umuman olganda, muallif itlar eng yaxshi uy hayvoni deb ishonadi, chunki ular umrbod eng yaxshi do'stingizga aylanadi.

patterns.exampleEn: I don't think dogs are shy animals.
First of all, dogs are loyal. Furthermore, they are useful.
patterns.exampleUz: Avvalo, itlar sodiq. Bundan tashqari, ular foydali.

patterns.exampleEn: On the other hand, dogs need attention. However, it's a small price to pay.
patterns.exampleUz: Boshqa tomondan, itlarga e'tibor kerak. Biroq, bu arzimas narx.

patterns.formula: All in all, I believe (that) + GAP.
patterns.exampleEn: All in all, I believe that dogs are the best pets.
patterns.exampleUz: Umuman olganda, itlar eng yaxshi uy hayvoni deb ishonaman.
